portal_hypertension.title: Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis in non-cirrhotic portal hypertension secondary to primary myelofibrosis: A rare case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Pradana FR, Nuramalia LS, Maimunah U
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：自发性细菌性腹膜炎 (SBP) 是一种危及生命的腹水感染，通常与肝硬化和晚期门脉高压相关，而其在非肝硬化门脉高压 (NCPH) 中的发生很少见，且常常未被充分认识。 临床提示：原发性骨髓纤维化 (PMF) 是一种骨髓增殖性肿瘤，可能通过高凝状态、髓外造血和脾肿大相关的血流动力学变化等机制导致 NCPH；然而，SBP 在这
portal_hypertension.abstract: Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis (SBP) is a life-threatening infection of ascitic fluid, typically associated with cirrhosis and advanced portal hypertension, while its occurrence in non-cirrhotic portal hypertension (NCPH) is rare and often underrecognized. Primary myelofibrosis (PMF), a myeloproliferative neoplasm, may lead to NCPH through mechanisms such as hypercoagulability, extramedullary hematopoiesis, and splenomegaly-related hemodynamic changes; however, SBP in this setting is extremely uncommon.
